chunks: They will say, while they are in it disputing among themselves.
ai.seo_question: What are the disbelievers doing in Hell according to Surah Ash-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse depicts the disbelievers in Hell engaged in futile quarreling, shifting blame upon one another as they confront the reality of their deeds. Shia exegesis highlights this as a manifestation of their spiritual disarray, where the lack of inner coherence leads to external discord, serving as a warning against the fragmentation caused by rejecting divine guidance.
